statement: Research demonstration of the native Curve Smash six-class distinguished-point verifier on the planted 25-bit j=0 curve. The job is harness/fixtures/sixclass_p25.json in crypto-autoresearcher, with log 12345 known for conformance. This example is not a security frontier or a funded external prize. The verifier checks each class key and aG+bQ point equation natively; walker provenance is subject to sampled re-walk auditing.
